name: graphics-workbench
description: PDF and image tools for VS Code, including trimming, merging, splitting, conversion, Draw.io export, and LaTeX figure insertion.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['out', 'media/webview']) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.lint: oxlint src test webview/apps webview/shared webview/*.ts scripts .github/scripts .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src test webview/apps webview/shared webview/*.ts scripts .github/scripts .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --config ./oxfmt.config.ts --check src test webview/apps webview/shared package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json webview/tsconfig.json webview/tsconfig.test.json webview/*.ts scripts .github/scripts/*.mjs .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.format:fix: oxfmt --config ./oxfmt.config.ts --write src test webview/apps webview/shared package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json webview/tsconfig.json webview/tsconfig.test.json webview/*.ts scripts .github/scripts/*.mjs .vscode-test.mjs playwright.config.mjs commitlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts oxlint.config.ts
scripts.compile:webview: npm run compile:webview:crop_pdf && npm run compile:webview:merge_pdf && npm run compile:webview:split_pdf && npm run compile:webview:rotate_pdf && npm run compile:webview:reorder_pdf
scripts.test:webview: npm run test:webview:crop_pdf && npm run test:webview:merge_pdf && npm run test:webview:split_pdf && npm run test:webview:rotate_pdf && npm run test:webview:reorder_pdf
scripts.test:webview:coverage: npm run test:webview:crop_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:merge_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:split_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:rotate_pdf -- --coverage && npm run test:webview:reorder_pdf -- --coverage
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run compile:test && npm run compile:webview
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:webview && npm run typecheck:webview:test
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:extension-meta && npm run check:nls && npm run check:unused && npm run check:webview-warnings && npm run test:scripts
scripts.check:fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format:fix
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:coverage:run
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:vsix
